source.quote: SMSL's own page for the LIN.LIN.LIN M20, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « Using 4 pieces of Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoding chip CS43131 and carefully designed circuits; »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, supports PCM up to 32bit/768kHz and DSD up to DSD256; »

facts.chip: Four Cirrus Logic CS43131 (« Using 4 pieces of Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoding chip CS43131 »); two TPA6120A2 for the headphone stage.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_USB_1_1_mode: The page offers « a choice between USB 1.1 and USB 2.0 modes »; the ceiling recorded is the USB 2.0 one.
